about.text: This appeal concerns a dispute over alleged voter intimidation by private citizens investigating claims of election fraud following the 2020 presidential election. Shortly following the election, Shawn Smith, Ashley Epp, and Holly Kasun (collectively, Individual Defendants) formed an unincorporated association, United States Election Integrity Plan (USEIP), to investigate what they believed was large scale election fraud.
